_comment: THE SETTLED TRIO WITH EWL DISARMED — the single-knob contrast against
_simnet60_tri_slant_trio_480.  Same build, same fixture, same 480-epoch
window, same traces; `network.mw_wl.ewl_enable` is the ONLY key that
differs.
WHY: the recorded trio_480 result DIVERGES (EWL 74.7% -> 5.0% at true
integer, per-band ~1720 cyc).  WL-2 was previously exonerated on the FOLD
side (0 folded), but the fold is not the only thing ewl_enable does.
ApplicationNetwork.cpp:667 forms
ewl_carry_exclude = carry_invariant && nmw.ewl_enable
so with carry_invariant on — which the trio arms — the pair EXCLUDES the
third band's DD ambiguity chords from the invariant carry.  Under Odijk
Sect 5.1 the third band carries the only estimable code bias in a slant
network, so the exclusion removes carry from the band the posture exists
to determine.  '0 folded' does not exonerate an EXCLUSION.
PRE-REGISTERED PREDICTIONS (state before reading the result):
H1 EWL-exclusion is a/the driver -> per-band settled med|e| returns to
the float class (~5-9 cyc, not ~1720) and settled EWL climbs back
toward the float arm's 74.7%.
H2 EWL is innocent -> the runaway survives at ~1000-1800 cyc, matching
trio_480 within noise, and the remaining suspects stand (tree re-hosts
refolding invariant carry; chord-carry x slant-iono feedback).
Either outcome is informative; H2 also RE-exonerates the lane properly,
on the exclusion mechanism rather than only the fold.
GRADING NOTE — the float twin (_simnet60_tri_slant_480_ddint) is NOT a
clean comparator for either arm: it omits carry_invariant, so R.pl_amb is
populated there and BOTH RAIM tiers run (and false-fire: T3 5.4% of cells
at 2.7e7x implied alpha on truth-clean data), while on any carry_invariant
arm the pool is empty and RAIM is structurally inert.  Grade THIS arm
against trio_480 only.
Loader: ewl_enable OFF with carry_invariant ON is legal and quiet
(GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:6193 errors only on the reverse).
=== RESULT, 2026-08-13 — H2. EWL IS EXONERATED ON THE EXCLUSION TOO. ===
480/480 emitted, exit 0, 517 s, exe 02076F44.  QC telemetry BIT-IDENTICAL
to the baseline (T1 263942 opp / 0 flag; T2 474/0; T3-T6 0 opp — RAIM
inert on both arms because both arm carry_invariant), so the contrast is
single-knob clean.  Graded by scripts/simnet_amb_integer.py against
runs/simnet60_tri, same window, both arms:
settled (last 25%)   EWL ARMED    EWL OFF     change
L1C med|e|            2303.6 cyc   3779.1 cyc  +64% WORSE
EWL round(e)=0           1.8%         1.9%     flat
full-window EWL round=0 32.4%        25.7%     -6.7 pts worse
full-window WL  round=0 10.3%         6.5%     -3.8 pts worse
Disarming the lane does NOT fix the runaway and does not improve any
graded channel.  The audit hypothesis — that ewl_carry_exclude
(ApplicationNetwork.cpp:667) drives the trio divergence by withholding
third-band chords from the invariant carry — is FALSIFIED.  The exclusion
is real in code; it is not the cause.  Remaining suspects from
project_slant_triple_handoff stand: tree re-hosts refolding invariant
carry (456), chord-carry x slant-iono feedback.
READ WITH CARE: BOTH arms are catastrophically diverged (thousands of
cycles; this arm's consumer ends 585 m 3D).  This is a contrast between
two broken states, so 'worse' is NOT evidence the lane is beneficial —
it is evidence the lane is not the lever.
